name: Högstad - Strömstad
routeType: point-to-point official Bohusleden stage; medium final northern stage from Högstad through forest paths, small roads, farmland, archaeological landscapes and bedrock toward central Strömstad and the harbour/station area

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: Stage 27 Högstad - Strömstad
keyFacts: Canonical official name is 27. Högstad - Strömstad.
Official direction is Högstad to Strömstad, although official/regional text notes the stage can be walked as either the first or final stage.
West Sweden Trails facts are 15 km, 5 h and medium/blue.
Official API length is 15000 m and the geometry has 1983 coordinates before de-duplication.
Surfaces include asphalt, dirt road and forest path; official narrative also describes country roads, agricultural landscape, exposed bedrock, ancient monuments and urban/town approach.
Official route description highlights the Rogstad/Hillern viewpoint/shelter detour, Blomsholm context and the final approach to central Strömstad.
Official access text identifies Högstad and Strömstad as reachable by car and public transport, mentions Blomsholmsmotet along the stage, and says Strömstad has bus and train connections.
WST status API returned an empty list on 2026-04-30T02:07:50Z.
caveats: The direct GPX filename is Etapp27_Krokstrand_stromstad.gpx even though the stage identity and geometry are Högstad - Strömstad.
WST map/API token URLs are embedded in the page and may need refresh; cite the page and tokenized API pattern rather than a stale token.
GPX elevations are zero/unusable.
WST place data includes endpoint and city-service POIs; do not treat all Strömstad services as on-route natural trail facilities.

generalRules: General allemansrätten camping may apply where no local signs, land-use conflicts or special rules prohibit it, but avoid homes, farms, cultivated land, pasture and sensitive terrain.
Stage 27 passes agricultural/farmland areas; do not camp or take shortcuts on cultivated land or near livestock.
Länsstyrelsen fire-ban layer reported no active fire ban for Strömstad at 2026-04-30T02:06:00Z, but this is volatile and must not be imported as static data.
Use prepared fire places, avoid fires on bedrock, do not take live branches or windfalls, and recheck Krisinformation/Länsstyrelsen/Strömstad fire-ban status before use.

No second research batch required because official identity, primary geometry, endpoints, access, facilities, water/camping/fire and rules/currentness are sufficiently covered; remaining work is normalization-time de-duplication, facility clustering, live timetable/status/fire checks, endpoint service filtering and final GIS overlay.

importReadiness.summary: Stage 27 has strong official identity, exact official geometry, corroborated endpoints, fixed transit at both ends, a clear core facility set and rules/currentness findings. It should not be integrated directly into runtime data until duplicate-coordinate cleanup, endpoint service filtering, live timetable/status/fire checks, forestry currentness verification, water/toilet season checks and final GIS overlays are complete.
normalizationCaveats: Use WST/Hoodin official GPX/API as primary; do not use Västsverige KMZ/KML as route geometry.
Collapse 1983 raw official points to 661 effective vertices before length/line processing.
Treat the GPX filename Krokstrand_stromstad as stale filename only; canonical endpoint is Högstad.
Do not import a guaranteed on-route drinking-water source; Rogstad rainwater is not potable and Strömstad endpoint taps are pending/access metadata.
Filter Strömstad endpoint service POIs carefully; most are endpoint/access metadata, not core trail facilities.
Use Högstad stop and Strömstad station as primary transit records after live timetable checks.
Treat Skogsstyrelsen A 60768-2022 as currentness/field-check caution only, not closure.
Use fire-ban status only as live data, never as static import.
importReadiness.confidence: high for identity/endpoints/geometry and Strömstad endpoint access; medium-high for core facilities and Högstad access; medium for endpoint water/toilet seasonality, forestry-currentness and live status
